node.title: Re: Perl/Tk menu and commands based on array
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [richie],

Just to expand briefly on what [tybalt89] mentioned: In Perl, closures like "sub {$fname = "$_"; &Restart}" in your code only "close over" lexicals (defined with my), and not global/package variables, that is those defined with our, or many of the [doc://perlvar|special variables]. $_ is one of those special variables that is a global. Whenever sub {$fname = "$_"} is executed, it will access the current value of $_.

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
